overview: A 30-bed multi-speciality hospital with a 4-bed ICU, 2 modular operation theatres, 24x7 emergency, in-house pathology and digital radiology, serving Nashik city and nearby talukas where no NABH-entry-level hospital exists within 15 km.
scheme: SBI Doctor Plus / Healthcare Term Loan
affil: Dr. Sharma: 9 yrs Consultant Surgeon at Wockhardt Hospital, Nashik. Dr. Kulkarni: 12 yrs Physician at Apollo Hospital, Nashik. Dr. Patil: 8 yrs Obstetrician at Civil Hospital, Nashik.
services: Normal & C-section deliveries, laparoscopic surgeries, fracture fixation, ICU care, dialysis referral, health check-up packages.
usp: Only 24x7 multi-speciality hospital with ICU and modular OT within 15 km of Nashik Road; senior consultant-led care at mid-market tariffs.

equip.item: Modular OT Table, Lights & Anaesthesia Workstation

vendor: MedEquip Solutions Pvt Ltd (Siemens / Philips authorised dealer)
segments: Mothers & newborns, elderly with chronic disease, industrial-area workers (MIDC Sinnar), highway trauma cases on Mumbai-Nashik highway.
referral: Tie-ups with 40 GPs in Nashik Road & Deolali, monthly health camps, corporate tie-ups with 6 MIDC companies, own ambulance network.
tpa: Empanelment with 12 TPAs/insurers in year 1; MJPJAY / PM-JAY empanelment applied.
competitors: City Hospital (8 km, 50 beds, multi-speciality), Shree Nursing Home (3 km, 15 beds, maternity only), Civil Hospital (6 km, government).
sw_s: Experienced promoter doctors with existing patient base of ~1,800/month; owned premises; strong GP referral network.
sw_w: New brand in first 2 years; dependence on visiting consultants for super-speciality cases.
sw_o: Growing population of Nashik Road & MIDC; rising insurance coverage; PM-JAY / MJPJAY volumes; no ICU-equipped hospital within 15 km.
sw_t: Entry of corporate hospital chains; changes in scheme package rates; staff attrition (nurses).
bmw: Agreement with authorised CBWTF (Nashik Waste Management), colour-coded segregation at source, daily collection.
eco: 40 kW rooftop solar, rainwater harvesting, sewage treatment plant (STP), LED lighting.
